maya: Heads-up — I want to propose a lighter payload validation flow for on-prem bundles that doesn't require online signer verification (for air-gapped installs). Operators are getting blocked waiting for external signer endpoints.
kevin: +1. Clarify the goal: fast sanity checks only, or full crypto attestation when possible?
anika: We can do a staged model: quick local checksum + schema validation first, then full attestation when connectivity is restored.
lee: Safety note — we must make activation reversible. Atomic swap with a clear rollback path avoids messy partial applies.
maya: Proposal sketch to discuss: 
1) Bundle manifest with content-addressed blobs + per-component sha256.
2) Optional operator-signed token included in bundle metadata (supports HSM/GPG/PEM).
3) Verifier agent runs local checksum, schema, and license checks.
4) Two-phase activation: unpack -> verify hashes -> advertise candidate -> commit (or rollback).
kevin: For the operator-signed token, many customers won't have HSMs; GPG is common. We should accept multiple sig formats but make verification pluggable.
anika: Also support a signerless mode where an operator explicitly opts in — we then enforce stricter quarantine and telemetry.
maya: Exactly. Signerless mode must come with an enforced quarantine window and operator ack before traffic is routed.
lee: Suggest policy config: if signerless then network egress is disabled for X minutes and an explicit `approve-activation` step required.
ops-bot: deploy-checker job #7345 run: https://ci.redwood/v/7345 — artifact verifier failed on checksum mismatch in v2 bundles :rotating_light:
kevin: Quick verify example:
```
redwood-verify --manifest /tmp/manifest.json --blob-dir /var/lib/redwood/blobs
```
returns non-zero on mismatch.
anika: Rollback UX: expose `redwood-apply --rollback <activation-id>` and surface diffs in console so operator knows what changed.
maya: UX note: preflight should show file-level diffs, estimated downtime, and an easy operator-facing decision point. Keep humans in the loop. :+1:
lee: Also add console metrics: failed-validations, quarantine-count, time-to-commit, and number of signerless activations. Instrument errors with sample bundle IDs for debugging.
kevin: I'll draft an RFC with manifest proto (fields + sig envelope) and two-mode flow (signed vs signerless). Will include a minimal verifier reference implementation.
maya: Great — please cc @eng-sre and @product-security on the RFC. Sync tomorrow 11:00 to run through failure modes.
